_comment: Per-model prices, per million tokens, with the date each was taken from the vendor's
published list. A model with no entry here raises UnpricedModel rather than being costed
with someone else's rates: the ledger's accuracy is the only cost control this phase has,
and a wrong price does not fail, it quietly mis-states the running total.
Adding a model is a line here. Nothing in the code needs to change.

deepseek-flash.taken: 2026-10-02, https://api-docs.deepseek.com/zh-cn/quick_start/pricing/ ; CNY peak list rates used as a conservative fixed estimate. Off-peak list rates are half; this is not time-dependent billing or the account invoice.

deepseek-v4.1-flash.taken: 2026-10-03, help.aliyun.com/zh/model-studio/deepseek-v4-1-flash, Beijing busy-hour published reference price; no idle-hour or plan discount assumed, so a prepaid token plan is booked at or above what it costs
